rule: Claude and OpenCode may be used freely. Codex is a fallback only and its share of daily AI-agent work must stay at or below 30 percent. Prefer free cloud agents for heavy work and local agents only for bounded low-load work. Paid APIs and paid GPU are never used.
measurement: Share of AI-agent dispatch work recorded in the shared state/ai-agent-reports.jsonl report log within the rolling daily window. A Codex dispatch is hard-blocked while Codex's recorded share is at or above the cap, so the day cannot finish above 30 percent paid-fallback work.

enforcement.planner: SKIP_CODEX when the recorded share is already at or above the cap
enforcement.dispatcher: PAID_QUOTA_EXCEEDED before any Codex invocation when the recorded share is at or above the cap

nonGoals: This policy does not measure or spend money, APIs or GPU; it only gates Codex dispatch against the shared daily record. It never writes to the report log itself.
